content_sections.heading: Canara Bank Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Canara Bank has announced 3500 training seats across states and Union Territories. Candidates can opt for training seats in only one state. The seats are provisional and may vary according to the actual requirement of the Bank. Abbreviations used in the notification: SC - Scheduled Caste; ST - Scheduled Tribe; OBC - Other Backward Classes; EWS - Economically Weaker Section; UR - Unreserved Category; PwBD - Persons with Benchmark Disability; VI - Visually Impaired; HI - Hearing Impaired; OC - Orthopedically Challenged; ID - Intellectual Disability. Candidates can opt for training seats in only ONE STATE under this project. Candidates will be able to give their order of preference for all districts in the selected state. Allotment will be need based and subject to availability of training seats in the respective districts. The Bank reserves the right to allot a training seat in any district of the selected state as per administrative requirement. Candidates should ensure they fulfil the eligibility criteria as on the date of eligibility before applying. Candidates should check the Bank's website (www.canarabank.bank.in, Careers, Recruitment, Engagement of Graduate Apprentices in Canara Bank under Apprentices Act, 1961 for FY 2026-27) for details and updates.

content_sections.heading: Canara Bank Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit is a minimum of 20 years and a maximum of 28 years as on 01.09.2026. Candidates must have been born not earlier than 02.09.1998 and not later than 01.09.2006 (both days inclusive). The maximum age limit applies to General Category and EWS candidates. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying. Age relaxation for SC/ ST/ OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with only one of the remaining categories for which age relaxation is permitted. Candidates seeking age relaxation must submit the necessary certificate(s) in original along with photocopies at the time of document verification/ reporting for On-the-Job training and at any later stage required by the Bank. Reservation for PwBD is horizontal and within the overall training vacancies for the State. No Ex-servicemen/ Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an apprentice, and there is no reservation for them in this engagement. The candidate should not have undergone Apprenticeship Training with Canara Bank or any other organization earlier, should not be pursuing Apprenticeship Training under the Apprentices Act 1961, and should not have been terminated during Apprenticeship Training due to their own fault. Candidates who have undergone training or have job experience of one or more years after completing their educational qualification are not eligible. SC/ ST/ OBC/ PwBD candidates need a Caste/ Category Certificate issued by a competent authority in the format prescribed by the Government of India. OBC candidates need a valid OBC certificate with a non-creamy layer clause. OBC candidates who come under the creamy layer are not entitled to OBC reservation and should indicate their category as General in the online application.

content_sections.heading: Canara Bank Apprentice Reservation Details
content_sections.text: Reservation for SC/ ST/ OBC/ EWS/ PwBD candidates is as per the prescribed reservation percentages of the respective States/ UTs as per Government guidelines. Candidates from reserved categories, including those for whom no reservation is mentioned, may apply for unreserved vacancies if they fulfil all eligibility conditions applicable to the unreserved category. Under section 34 of "The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016", persons with benchmark disabilities are eligible for reservation. The post is identified as suitable for the following disability categories as defined in the Schedule of the RPwD Act 2016. Visual Impairment (VI): Persons with blindness (total absence of sight; visual acuity less than 3/ 60 or less than 10/ 200 (Snellen) in the better eye with best possible correction; or limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 10 degrees) or low vision (visual acuity not exceeding 6/ 18 or less than 20/ 60 up to 3/ 60 or up to 10/ 200 (Snellen) in the better eye with best possible correction; or limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 40 degrees up to 10 degrees). Hearing Impaired (HI): Deaf (70 DB hearing loss in speech frequencies in both ears) or Hard of Hearing (60 DB to 70 DB hearing loss in speech frequencies in both ears). Orthopedically Challenged/ Locomotor Disability (OC/ LD): Inability to execute distinctive activities associated with movement of self and objects resulting from affliction of the musculoskeletal or nervous system or both, including Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism (adult height of 4 feet 10 inches (147 centimeters) or less), Muscular Dystrophy, Acid Attack Victims, Spinal Deformity and Spinal Injury without any associated neurological/ limb dysfunction. Intellectual Disability (ID): Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), Specific Learning Disability (SLD) and Mental Illness (MI), as defined in the notification. Multiple Disabilities: Multiple disabilities among the categories above. Only persons with benchmark disabilities are eligible for reservation. A benchmark disability means not less than 40% of a specified disability, as certified by the certifying authority. Candidates must submit a disability certificate issued by a Competent Authority as per Government of India guidelines, which is subject to verification or re-verification at any point. PwBD reservation is not applicable on the basis of a temporary disability certificate. It is only for persons with irreversible permanent benchmark disability in terms of O.M. No. 36035/ 8/ 2023-Estt. (Res-II) dated 19.05.2023 of DoPT. Government guidelines may change from time to time. Persons not covered under the reservation schemes for SC, ST and OBC, and whose family gross annual income is below Rs. 8.00 lakh, are identified as EWS. content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable and includes GST. It is payable online only. Payment can be made by Debit Cards (RuPay/ Visa/ MasterCard/ Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards or Mobile Wallets. An e-receipt is generated after a successful transaction. content_sections.heading: Canara Bank Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is merit-based. The notification does not describe a written examination. Merit list: Prepared state-wise in descending order of marks/ percentage in 12th Std (HSC/ 10+2)/ Diploma Examination. Ties are ranked by age in descending order. Minimum marks: Not less than 60% (55% for SC/ ST/ PwBD) in 12th Std/ Diploma. Fractions are ignored, so 59.99% is treated as below 60% and 54.99% as below 55%. Document Verification and local language test: Conducted during the Document Verification process. Original documents are checked. Any discrepancy leads to summary disqualification. Final selection is subject to verification of eligibility and application information, qualification in the local language test of the opted State where applicable, and being declared medically fit. Where CGPA/ OGPA is awarded, it must be converted into percentage in the online application, with a certificate from the appropriate authority stating the conversion norms. Percentage is total marks obtained in all subjects in all semesters/ years divided by aggregate maximum marks, multiplied by 100. The merit list is prepared only on the information submitted in the online application.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Be Produced at the Time of Engagement
content_sections.text: Originals with a self-attested photocopy must be submitted, failing which the candidate may not be permitted to join. Valid system-generated printout of the online application. Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate from a Competent Authority or SSLC/ Std. X Certificate with date of birth). Photo ID: Passport, Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Driving License or any other photo ID issued by Statutory Authorities. Mark sheets/ certificates from SSC onwards to the highest examination passed, including semester/ year-wise mark sheets and the final degree, with proper Board/ University proof that the result was declared on or before the cut-off date. Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format (EWS candidates). Caste Certificate in the prescribed format (SC/ ST/ OBC). For OBC, the certificate must include the non-creamy layer clause, be valid as on the date of notification, and the caste name must tally letter by letter with the Government list. UDID card and Disability Certificate from a Medical Board (at least three members, including a specialist) in the prescribed format (PwBD candidates). Any other relevant documents in support of eligibility.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Canara Bank Graduate Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3500 Graduate Apprentice vacancies announced by Canara Bank under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for the financial year 2026-27 across various branches in India.

faq.question: Q2. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 01-10-2026 and the last date to submit the online application form is 17-10-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a recognized university by the Government of India, passed between 01.01.2023 and 01.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Canara Bank Graduate Apprentice?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 20 years and the maximum age limit is 28 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly stipend provided to the selected apprentices?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 16,650/- during the apprenticeship training period.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 500/- for all other categories, while SC/ST/PwBD candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Canara Bank Graduate Apprentice Recruitment?
faq.answer: First register on the NATS portal and obtain an enrollment ID. Then visit the official Canara Bank website, navigate to the careers section, fill out the online form, upload required documents, and submit it.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes registration on the NATS portal, online application, preparation of a merit list based on academic marks, document verification, and a local language test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Canara Bank?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official website at www.canarabank.bank.in for all recruitment-related updates, notifications, and application portals.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type and duration of this engagement?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based apprenticeship engagement under the Apprentices Act, 1961 designed to provide practical training to eligible graduate candidates.
